disruptions.text: Canada Line Track Maintenance on Wed, Sept 30 from 11:00 PM until the end of service.
disruptions.note:
Canada Line Track Maintenance on Wed, Sept 30 from 11:00 PM until the end of service. Trains will single-track between Bridgeport Station and Richmond-Brighouse Station. Please allow extra travel time.


The effective headways during this work are: 
Waterfront Station - Bridgeport Station - 10 minutes 
Bridgeport Station - Richmond-Brighouse Station - 20 minutes 
Bridgeport Station - YVR Airport Station - 20 minutes 

Last trains will depart stations approximately 5 minutes later than normal timetable stated times.
